rationale: At the DEFAULT monitoring level MSK publishes a small set of metrics aggregated over the whole cluster, which is enough to see that something is wrong and not enough to see where. A single broker saturating its network, a partition whose replicas have stopped catching up, or a consumer group falling behind are all invisible in the aggregate, and those are the shapes that an unexpected consumer, an unnoticed replication break or a partial outage take. Per-broker metrics are what make the difference between the two states observable while it matters.
remediation: Raise the monitoring level of the cluster to at least PER_BROKER, and to PER_TOPIC_PER_BROKER where the traffic of individual topics needs to be followed
